title: I built a Unity testing tool an AI agent runs itself. Watching Fable 5 use has been wild. Want to be a beta tester?
author: AgenticGameDev
selftext:
So I've been working on MooseRunner. The idea is simple: let an AI agent run and debug your Play Mode tests without you sitting there driving the Editor. [https://www.mooserunner.com/](https://www.mooserunner.com/)

This week I tried it with Claude's new Fable 5 and it went to the next level. It recorded a test run and analyzed the footage to see what went wrong. It set breakpoints and stepped through the live code. It paused and continued tests. It even spotted a few real bugs in MooseRunner and told me exactly where they were.                                                                                         

Anyway, I'm after a few beta testers. If you're on Unity 6.x on Windows and you work with an AI agent (recommend Claude Code), drop a comment or DM me. I just want honest feedback: what's confusing, what's broken, what's missing.

The Video is the raw test footage of one test the AI recorded of a VR multiuser music game I'm working on.
